locked_decisions.summary: Deterministic linter, not an entropy engine. Counting is inside this decision; scoring is outside it.
Coverage is measured against declared roots. Workspace-level coverage is not provable by any tool.

locked_decisions.status: accepted, PARTIALLY INVALIDATED by S002 — superseding ADR required
locked_decisions.summary: SARIF 2.1.0 as output-contract design source, SonarQube issue-lifecycle as state machine. SARIF is an export target later, not a v0.1 schema commitment.
locked_decisions.invalidation: The OSCAL observation/finding split remains adoptable, but the `incomplete` outcome cannot be inherited from OSCAL, which defines no not-assessed value. XCCDF is the better donor. Separately, the four-valued outcome mixes two axes and must be split.

locked_decisions.summary: Determinism defined against a named Normalization function. Specify it before the proof runs.

corrections_pending.claim: No SARIF object expresses analysis scope or coverage.
corrections_pending.replacement: SARIF carries per-result and per-artifact not-analysed primitives — result.kind, invocation.executionSuccessful, toolExecutionNotifications, artifact.roles analysisTarget — but defines no run-level coverage aggregate.
corrections_pending.note: Semgrep routes coverage through its native schema, not SARIF. A SARIF export loses the manifest. Decide before integration.

corrections_pending.claim: Notion rate limits scale 10/25/50/100 req/s by plan.
corrections_pending.replacement: Notion documents an average of three requests per second per connection. The workspace ceiling is 'scaled to the workspace's plan' with no tier table. At 3 req/s the three-minute warm-scan kill criterion is a budget of roughly 540 requests.

corrections_pending.claim: OSCAL supplies the observation/finding split including an incomplete outcome.
corrections_pending.replacement: Write a superseding ADR. Do not edit ADR-0003 in place.

asserted_without_adr: First release scope: selective block crawl. REF001 reads hyperlinks inside blocks, so metadata-only cannot implement a built-in rule.
Resource identity in config: stable IDs with readable aliases.
Baseline policy: report old debt, fail new only.
CI timing: after local core release.
Page titles in CI output: redact by default.
Minimum rule set: SYS001, REF001, REQ001, UNQ001.
Validation shape: build at n=1 against this workspace, release at n=3.

open_decisions.detail: Replace the flat four-value enum with two orthogonal fields — conformity and evidence-sufficiency — and move `inapplicable` into the scope declaration. Add a report-level disclaimer disposition so a pervasively incomplete scan can refuse to render a summary verdict. Adopt the XCCDF rule that a non-verdict never enters a scoring denominator.
open_decisions.due: before the 72-hour proof, because it determines what the proof measures

open_decisions.detail: Model the coverage manifest as a staged funnel after CONSORT and PRISMA: declared roots → resolved → fetched → rules evaluated, every drop-out carrying a specific machine-readable cause and a named resource. Generic reasons are banned. Consider Configuration Status Accounting — a standing record fed by each scan rather than a per-scan artifact that is discarded.
workspace-lint is trademark-clean and npm-blocked; every notion-* candidate is npm-available and trademark-blocked. Shortlist and npm view evidence in docs/research/name-and-legal.md.

Three live framings: configured rules, zero-config decay report, coverage proof. The demand test chooses. New tiebreaker from S002: acquisition cost. The decay-report buyer is reachable in r/Notion for free; the coverage-proof buyer has no public channel.
Controlled-vocabulary membership (uncovered, testable, voiced). Orphan detection (deferral reason removed by ADR-0002). Duplicate-title should move from configured UNQ001 to built-in.

api_target.requirement: must carry request_status; its absence from a paginated list response is a hard error, never evidence of completeness
api_target.rate_limit_verified: average of 3 requests per second per connection; workspace ceiling scaled to plan, amount undisclosed
api_target.admin_content_search: Enterprise-only, reaches private pages, exports CSV — but it is a search, not an enumeration. Kill criterion 'Notion ships first-party coverage certification' did not fire.

unknowns_assigned_to_proof: Does a child_page block stay visible after the child's access is revoked?
Does a property ID survive a property type change?
Is result order stable across two identical paginated calls?
Does the ~11,200-object search ceiling still hold?
Is Semgrep's `skipped` output verbose-gated? The CLI reference does not say; test empirically.
Do any two values of the split outcome vocabulary ever collapse in practice? Test against a workspace with a deliberately unshared subtree.

research.known_blind_spot: Research agents cannot reach Reddit; community.notion.so and forum.notion.so no longer resolve. This is a limitation of the tooling, NOT of the channel — the operator reaches Reddit and has converted a buyer there. Evidence still skews toward people who publish.

citation_hazards: ISO 19011:2018 was read from a site hosting a complete unauthorised copy including its intact copyright page. Wording and clause numbers are genuine and verified. The URL must never appear in a published artifact. Cite the clause and link the ISO catalogue.
The squarespace-hosted ISA 705 mirror is unofficial. Cite paragraph numbers and point at IAASB.
Reached only through consultancy paraphrase and not citable at clause level: ISO 9001, ISO 13485, EIA-649, ISO 10007, MIL-STD-973, AICPA AT-C 320.

inputs.note: None canonical. The PRD carries URLs and dates; the decay synthesis carries reasoning without URLs; the recruiting sweep carries claimed search coverage without URLs and a same-day correction block. Evidentiary weights differ and the files record that.

operator_rulings: No ghostwriting. Produce content specifications for anything he will send as himself, never drafted first-person copy. The literal-humanist-voice register governs how the agent writes; it does not license writing as him.
